title: Heisenberg's heavy-water program and deuterium-reactor UFO propulsion

tellings.quote: a lot of the rumors around, you know, UFOs and how they fly involve a dutyium reactor, you know, in the middle, like a heavy water engine.

plain: Many of the rumours about how UFOs fly involve a reactor in the middle of the craft that runs on deuterium, a heavy kind of hydrogen. Put another way, a heavy-water engine. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, and ties it to the German physicist Werner Heisenberg's wartime heavy-water work in Nazi Germany in the 1940s. He also mentions the physicist Luis Walter Alvarez, suggesting that this old nuclear research might hold a clue to how such craft are powered.
